prompt: HBr is added to 2-methyl-2-butene in the presence of peroxides (ROOR) and light. Draw the alkyl bromide product.

answers.label: 2-bromo-3-methylbutane (anti-Markovnikov; Br on LESS substituted alkene C)

traps.note: Without peroxides HBr adds Markovnikov; peroxides flip it anti-Markovnikov.

explanation: Peroxides initiate: Br• adds to the LESS substituted carbon (giving the more stable tertiary carbon radical as intermediate), then abstracts H from HBr. Net: Br on the originally less substituted alkene C.
